requirements.statement: subtotal_cents must be a JSON integer >= 0. Reject null, strings, booleans, negative and fractional values with VALIDATION_ERROR and null shipping_cents and total_cents.
For standard shipping, charge 500 cents below subtotal 5000, otherwise zero. Total equals subtotal plus shipping.

For express shipping, charge 1200 cents for every valid subtotal. Reject any other method with VALIDATION_ERROR and null shipping_cents and total_cents. Total equals subtotal plus shipping when valid.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Valid nonnegative integer subtotal is accepted with a supported shipping method.
Invalid subtotal types or values return VALIDATION_ERROR without fee or total.
Standard fee is 500 below 5000; total is subtotal plus 500.
Standard fee is zero at and above 5000; total equals subtotal.
Express fee is always 1200 for a valid subtotal; total is subtotal plus 1200.
Unsupported shipping methods return VALIDATION_ERROR without fee or total.

design_rules: Inputs: subtotal_cents and method. Output: status, shipping_cents and total_cents.
Do not coerce strings or booleans to numbers. Treat a JSON number with a fractional value as invalid.
Quotes are stateless. No network, account, payment or production integration is involved.
business_rules: All amounts are integer cents. There are no discounts, taxes or additional fees in scope.

risks.description: Off-by-one threshold or accidental type coercion changes a quote.

test_scope: Functional shipping quotes, subtotal validation and shipping-method validation.
coverage_rules: Cover all acceptance criteria with observable expected results.
Cover zero and just below, exactly at, and just above the standard threshold.
Cover express shipping below and at or above the standard threshold.
Cover null, string, boolean, negative and fractional subtotals and an unsupported method.
